text:
Priya: Quick sync — we need a terse status on the v2 cutover lanes. Specifically: client SDKs, proxy shim, docs, and any remaining infra deps. Who's owning what for the next milestone?

Ben: I can own client SDK rollouts (JS + Python). ETA for PRs merged into main is EOD Thu. Still have one failing unit test in streaming that I'm debugging.

Carlos: I have runtime compatibility checks running against the canary model pool. Found an edge case with long-prefix KV cache invalidation; patch incoming today. Will signal if that affects the shim.

Alice: Docs side — I need final API surface and examples. Ben, can you confirm whether we keep both old header names for a week during the flag gate?

Ben: Plan is: accept both X-Redwood-API-Version: 1|2 for 7 days, then drop v1. We'll surface a deprecation warning in response headers when v1 is used. Example:

```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
X-Redwood-Deprecation: v1 will be removed 2026-04-10
```

Dana: Infra check — proxy shim (edge) needs a small timeout tweak, and cert rotation script updated for the new endpoints. I can flip the shim flag in staging tomorrow; need someone to run end-to-end smoke.

Priya: Who can run e2e smoke once shim flag is on staging? Prefer someone oncall-clear next 24h.

Carlos: I can run it after I finish the KV patch, probably ~3pm PT. What test harness do you want?

Alice: I can run the doc examples against staging too. Ping me the SDK build artifact name so I can point snippets to it.

Ben: SDK CI will produce artifacts under `gs://redwood-sdk-builds/v2-canary/{pkg}-{sha}.tar.gz`. I'll post the exact artifact when CI completes.

infra-bot: Reminder: canary cluster scaling scheduled 2026-03-18 02:00 UTC. Shard B will be drained then.

Priya: Good catch — avoid running heavy canary tests during that window. Carlos, can you shift to after 05:00 UTC if it looks risky?

Carlos: Yep, I'll avoid the drain window. If KV patch is safe I'll run at 08:00 UTC.

Ben: One more thing — SDK callers need a minor header change: new `Redwood-Model` header supports a comma-separated fallback list. Example: `Redwood-Model: redwood-v2,redwood-v1` That requires a parser tweak but should be backward compatible. I'll open a short PR.

Dana: On the shim timeout: change 120s -> 140s for streaming proxied calls. Small but avoids client disconnects during longer responses. I'll send a diff.

Priya: Ownership summary for milestone:
- Client SDKs: Ben (merge by Thu EOD)
- Runtime KV fix: Carlos (patch today, e2e after infra drain)
- Proxy shim + timeout/cert: Dana (staging flag tomorrow)
- Docs + examples: Alice (sync with Ben's artifact)

Priya: Dependencies called out: SDK artifact availability, canary cluster drain window, and model fallback header PR. If anyone needs help, call it out here.

Ben: I'll post the artifact link and PR number once CI passes.

Carlos: Patch pushed to `eng-runtime/kv-invalidate-fix`, running unit + integration CI now. Will report back.

Alice: I'll mark doc PR as draft and then update with artifact link.

Dana: Shim flag toggled in staging at 09:30 PT tomorrow. I'll drop a notification to #eng-oncall before flipping.

Priya: Thanks. Quick Q: do we want an explicit canary group for third-party integrators during the grace period? Might help find SDK edge cases.

Ben: I like that. We can create an opt-in canary token and track usage via the console. I'll add a ticket.

Priya: Awesome. If nothing else, let's reconvene async with links. Post PRs + artifact links here and I'll close out ownership. :thumbsup:
